blurb: Guests fish for various species including striped bass, bluefish, fluke, porgies, and blackfish in the Long Island Sound. Captain Joe Somers holds a 100 Ton Ocean Operator License and has been in the charter business since 1978. The vessel Moontide is also used for research, surveys, and as a camera boat for the movie industry.
